feats.title: Press the Advantage
feats.description: If you score a critical hit while you have combat advantage, you gain combat advantage against the target until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Speedy Response
feats.description: If you are hit by an opportunity attack while moving, you gain a +1 bonus to speed for that move. This benefit is cumulative if you are hit multiple times.

feats.title: Surprising Charge
feats.description: When you make a charge attack against a target that is granting combat advantage to you, the attack deals 1[W] extra damage if you hit with a light blade.

feats.title: Dirty Fighting
feats.description: You gain a +4 bonus to melee weapon damage rolls against surprised enemies.

feats.title: Into the Fray
feats.description: During the surprise round and the first round of an encounter, you gain a +1 bonus to your speed and to your melee attack rolls.

feats.title: Opportunity Knocks
feats.description: Whenever you hit with an opportunity attack, or when an enemy misses you with an opportunity attack, the enemy you hit or the enemy that missed you grants combat advantage to you until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Risky Shift
feats.description: Whenever you shift, you can shift 1 additional square. If you do so, you grant combat advantage until the start of your next turn.

feats.title: Two-Fisted Shooter
feats.description: You can treat the hand crossbow as an off-hand weapon, and you can reload it one-handed as a free action. When you score a critical hit and have a loaded hand crossbow in your off hand, you can make a ranged basic attack with that weapon as a free action.

feats.title: Versatile Duelist
feats.description: You gain proficiency with all one-handed, military heavy blades. If a rogue power requires you to wield a light blade, you can use that power with a one-handed heavy blade and can also deal your Sneak Attack damage while using a one-handed heavy blade with that power.

feats.title: Reckless Scramble
feats.description: When a power lets you shift, you can instead choose to move that distance + 2 squares.

feats.title: Aggressive Assault
feats.description: At the beginning of an encounter, whenever you hit a target that has not yet acted, you slide that target 1 square.

feats.title: Brutal Wound
feats.description: When your attack deals ongoing damage and you deal Sneak Attack damage to the target, add 1 to the ongoing damage for every die of Sneak Attack damage dealt.

feats.title: Improved Cunning Sneak
feats.description: When you make a Stealth check to become hidden using your Cunning Sneak class feature, you must end a move action at least 2 squares away from your starting position instead of 3.

feats.title: Ruthless Injury
feats.description: When you use a club or a mace to make a sneak attack that causes the target to become blinded, immobilized, slowed, or weakened, that target takes a –2 penalty to saving throws against any of those conditions.

feats.title: Backstabber
feats.description: The extra damage dice from your Sneak Attack class feature increase from d6s to d8s.

feats.title: Underhanded Tactics
feats.description: Whenever you deal Sneak Attack damage, you can forgo rolling 1 die of that damage to impose a -2 penalty to the target's attack rolls until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Blade and Buckler
feats.description: The shield bonus to defenses from your light shield increase to +2.

feats.title: Buckler Duelist
feats.description: If a rogue power gives you a power bonus to defenses and you wield a light shield, increase that bonus by 1.

feats.title: Swashbuckling Specialist
feats.description: While wielding a rapier, if you are the only creature adjacent to the target you may use your sneak attack damage even if you do not have combat advantage against the target with this attack.

feats.title: Surprise Knockdown
feats.description: If you score a critical hit while you have combat advantage, you knock the target prone.
